about: Machine-readable availability record for every model feature of the PIT evaluation (docs/PIT_PROTOCOL.md). experiments/pit/guard.py refuses any feature that is absent here, marked excluded, or whose computed availability timestamp is later than the row's prediction time. Naming conventions are never used to infer availability.

timestamps.statement_available_at: 23:59:59 on the filing (ACTUAL) or statutory-deadline (STANDARDIZED) date: KAP financial reports are filed after the session close (MKK General Letter 1000, item 6)
timestamps.prediction_time: 18:00 on the prediction (entry) date; the position is entered at that day's close

modes.ACTUAL_FILING_DATE: statement availability = verified public date per ticker and fiscal year (data/pit/filing_dates_sample.csv); rows without one are unavailable
modes.STANDARDIZED_CONSERVATIVE_CUTOFF: statement availability = statutory deadline per fiscal year (data/pit/reporting_deadlines.csv; ticker rows override the general row); the cutoff must be on or after it

features.name: revenue
features.observation_period: fiscal year T (1 Jan T - 31 Dec T; balance-sheet items at 31 Dec T)
features.transformation: value as reported: net sales, income statement; rank-normalised to a percentile within the cross-section
features.adjustment_basis: accounting values in nominal TRY as reported (FY2023 onward under TMS 29 inflation accounting)
features.earliest_usable_prediction: first trading day strictly after the fiscal-year-T annual report is public (ACTUAL mode: filing date; STANDARDIZED mode: statutory deadline, which the cutoff must not precede)

features.name: market_cap
features.source: Yahoo Chart API daily close and split events (data/pit/derived/price_panel_<spec>.csv, market_value_pit) x data/trusted_raw/shares_outstanding_manual.csv
features.observation_period: close of the last quote on or before the cutoff
features.transformation: quoted close at the reference date x year-end-T share count, both on the as-quoted basis (close x F(31 Dec T) x shares(31 Dec T)); excluded when the share record disagrees with Yahoo split history or the close series has an unexplained jump after 31 Dec T
features.adjustment_basis: unadjusted (as quoted) price x historical share count; replaces the published back-adjusted price x historical share count
features.earliest_usable_prediction: first trading day after the reference close

features.name: pe_ratio
features.observation_period: price at the reference close; statements of fiscal year T
features.transformation: market_cap / net_income (net_income > 0; |P/E| <= 1000); computed only where the published dataset had a value (inherits its rejection rules) and market_cap is PIT-valid
features.adjustment_basis: as-quoted market value over nominal accounting values
features.earliest_usable_prediction: later of the statement availability and the reference close

features.name: pb_ratio
features.observation_period: price at the reference close; statements of fiscal year T
features.transformation: market_cap / equity (equity > 0; |P/B| <= 100; 2024 balance-sheet rejections inherited); computed only where the published dataset had a value (inherits its rejection rules) and market_cap is PIT-valid
features.adjustment_basis: as-quoted market value over nominal accounting values
features.earliest_usable_prediction: later of the statement availability and the reference close

features.name: enterprise_value
features.observation_period: price at the reference close; statements of fiscal year T
features.transformation: market_cap + net_debt (2024 balance-sheet rejections inherited); computed only where the published dataset had a value (inherits its rejection rules) and market_cap is PIT-valid
features.adjustment_basis: as-quoted market value over nominal accounting values
features.earliest_usable_prediction: later of the statement availability and the reference close

features.name: ev_ebitda
features.observation_period: price at the reference close; statements of fiscal year T
features.transformation: enterprise_value / ebitda (ebitda > 0; |EV/EBITDA| <= 500); computed only where the published dataset had a value (inherits its rejection rules) and market_cap is PIT-valid
features.adjustment_basis: as-quoted market value over nominal accounting values
features.earliest_usable_prediction: later of the statement availability and the reference close

features.name: price_momentum_1y_pct
features.observation_period: 365 days ending at the reference close
features.transformation: adjclose(asof)/adjclose(asof-365d)-1, in %; set to null when an unexplained >25% one-day move lies inside the look-back
features.adjustment_basis: ratios of split- and dividend-adjusted closes (basis-invariant)
features.earliest_usable_prediction: first trading day after the reference close

features.name: price_momentum_2y_pct
features.observation_period: 730 days ending at the reference close
features.transformation: adjclose(asof)/adjclose(asof-730d)-1, in %; set to null when an unexplained >25% one-day move lies inside the look-back
features.adjustment_basis: ratios of split- and dividend-adjusted closes (basis-invariant)
features.earliest_usable_prediction: first trading day after the reference close

features.name: price_drawdown_from_3y_high_pct
features.observation_period: 3 years ending at the reference close
features.transformation: adjclose(asof)/max adjclose over 3 years - 1, in %; set to null when an unexplained >25% one-day move lies inside the look-back
features.adjustment_basis: ratios of split- and dividend-adjusted closes (basis-invariant)
features.earliest_usable_prediction: first trading day after the reference close

features.name: price_vs_bist100_1y_pct
features.observation_period: 365 days ending at the reference close
features.transformation: price_momentum_1y_pct minus XU100 1-year return over the same dates; set to null when an unexplained >25% one-day move lies inside the look-back
features.adjustment_basis: ratios of split- and dividend-adjusted closes (basis-invariant)
features.earliest_usable_prediction: first trading day after the reference close

features.name: price_history_years_available
features.observation_period: listing history up to the cutoff
features.transformation: years between the first Yahoo quote and the cutoff; set to null when an unexplained >25% one-day move lies inside the look-back
features.adjustment_basis: ratios of split- and dividend-adjusted closes (basis-invariant)
features.earliest_usable_prediction: first trading day after the reference close

features.name: price_data_available
features.observation_period: reference date
features.transformation: 1 if a non-stale quote exists at the reference date; set to null when an unexplained >25% one-day move lies inside the look-back
features.adjustment_basis: ratios of split- and dividend-adjusted closes (basis-invariant)
features.earliest_usable_prediction: first trading day after the reference close

features.name: price_adjclose_t
features.exclusion_reason: A level of a back-adjusted series depends on corporate actions after T; as-quoted price levels carry no cross-sectional meaning
features.observation_period: calendar year T
features.transformation: n/a
features.adjustment_basis: n/a
features.earliest_usable_prediction: never (excluded)

features.name: benchmark_same_year_return_pct
features.exclusion_reason: Identical for every company in a cross-section: no ranking information; replaced by price_vs_bist100_1y_pct
features.observation_period: calendar year T
features.transformation: n/a
features.adjustment_basis: n/a
features.earliest_usable_prediction: never (excluded)
